data.name: Azwa
data.gender_notes: Azwa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azwajah' meaning 'to decorate'. A name for a beautiful and elegant girl. The name Azwa carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azwa usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to the divine decree in the Quran, 'Allah sends his blessings upon those who believe and those who remember Him' (33:56).
data.etymology: Azwa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azwa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أزوى
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث معناه القوة والشدة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أزوى هو اسم مؤنث يعود إلى الأصول العربية، ويعني القوة والشدة. وقد وردت مشتقاته في القرآن الكريم، مما يزيد من تعزيز معناه ودلالاته الروحية في الثقافة الإسلامية. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الدول العربية للإشارة إلى الفتيات القويات والشديدات.

in_urdu.name: ازوا
in_urdu.meaning: عربی زبان میں اس کا مطلب طاقت و سختی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ازوا ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب طاقت، سختی اور مضبوطی ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں اس نام کی اہمیت اس کے عربی جڑوں کی وجہ سے ہے، جو قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر کی گئی ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشروں میں، یہ نام ان لڑکیوں کے لئے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو مضبوط، قابل اعتماد اور طاقتور ہوتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अज़वा
in_hindi.meaning: अज़वा नाम का अर्थ है शक्ति और सख्ती
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़वा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है शक्ति, सख्ती और दृढ़ता। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन लड़कियों के लिए चुना जाता है जो मजबूत, साहसी और आत्मविश्वासी होती हैं। इस नाम की गहरी जड़ें इस्लामी संस्कृति और अरबी भाषा में हैं।

in_pashto.name: ازوا
in_pashto.meaning: د ازوا نوم معنی دی ځواک او سختۍ
in_pashto.long_meaning: ازوا د ښځينو يوه نوم دی چې په پښتو ژبه کې د ځواک او سختۍ معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د پښتنو او افغانانو په کلتور کې د پام وړ دی، ځکه چې دا د قوت، زړورتیا او مضبوطۍ ښکارندوی دی. په پښتو ژبه کې، دا نوم د هغو ځوانو ميوؤ لپاره کارول کېږي چې قوي، زړوره او ځواکمنه وي.

in_english.name: Azwa
in_english.meaning: Strong and powerful, a symbol of resilience and determination
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azwa originates from Arabic roots, signifying strength, power, and resilience. Referenced in Quranic verses, Azwa embodies spiritual and moral fortitude. Historically, it has been used across Islamic cultures to denote courageous and determined individuals, particularly females. The name Azwa is associated with positive personality traits such as leadership, confidence, and tenacity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azwa is often given to girls as a sign of beauty and elegance. It suggests that the child will grow up to be a gracious and well-mannered young woman, admired by all for her lovely demeanour and attractive appearance. In many Muslim communities, the giving of names is an important cultural tradition, and choosing a name with attractive or impressive meaning adds to the sense of joy and pride felt by parents on the occasion of their child's birth.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Azwa lies in its underlying meaning 'to decorate'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that each person is a work of art, created by God with infinite beauty and design. The name Azwa serves as a reminder of the divine nature of our being, and the duty to adorn ourselves, both exteriorly and interiorly, with good character and virtuous deeds. As the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "God is beautiful and loves beauty." In this sense, the name Azwa can inspire us to strive for inner and outer beauty, reflecting the nature of the Most Beautiful of Creators.

trends: Azwa is a popular name among Muslims, particularly in the Middle East and South Asia.
There is a growing interest in the lives of the wives of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and Azwa is one of the most studied.
